input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restraint on Client. Section 2(a) grants a non-exclusive licence and expressly confirms Client is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise use competing software and services (subject only to TrueLink's IP and Client's confidentiality obligations under Section 10), which is better than the preferred position. Client's only covenants (Section 8: legal compliance, no misrepresentation of underwriting decisions, access limitation, content warranties) and the Section 7 anti-spam covenant are conduct restrictions, not restraints on the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build. The single reference to a "Non-Competition Agreement" (Section 8(d), p0054) operates as a limitation on TrueLink's licence to use Credit Data and therefore benefits us; its terms sit in a separate document and are noted only for diligence, not flagged here.
